attack.note: Rage builds from autos and abilities, then drives Seeing Red attack speed, Furzerker stacking auto bonuses and Bloodthirst lifesteal. Autos are central.

poke.note: Ez-Thro Dynamite is a slow lobbed skillshot, only light poke.

damage.note: Staggering Blow with Headbanger adds 8 percent of maximum health and a long stun, Furzerker stacks empowered autos and Bloodthirst heals him, so he kills single targets through healing. Hogg Wild and Loot Hoard add area damage and slows.

good_into.why: Staggering Blow stuns a target into terrain, Headbanger takes 8 percent of max health and Shockwave stuns a lane of heroes.
Percent health and burst through Headbanger and Shockwave damage ignore healing mostly, and Bloodthirst makes him out heal them.
Percent maximum health damage from Headbanger and armor reduction from Power Spike counters tanks.
Camp clear is the best in this set (4.6 camps per game), and Hoardapult can speed up objective pressure.

bad_into.why: Hogg Wild and Staggering Blow need to land, and stuns or silences interrupt his combo.
Slow ranged heroes can avoid Staggering Blow, and Ez-Thro Dynamite is easily dodged.
Armor and Rage heals take time, and burst before Rage builds kills him.
He must walk into ranged heroes with limited gap closers beyond Hogg Wild.

wants_from_team: Follow up crowd control or damage after Staggering Blow
A healer to boost his sustain with Hogger's Joggers
gives_team: Shockwave long line stun for team engage
